testcase.name: Scenario: Press Space after checking a staged command size option: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1709:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Press Space after checking a staged command size option ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And ribbon customization is open in the MCAD Software for an empty Part Tools custom panel ✔ And the available command category is All Commands in ascending name order ✔ When the user selects 2-D Drawing and clicks the add button ✔ Then 2-D Drawing is staged and 2D Sketches is selected in the available list ✔ When the user clicks the staged 2-D Drawing Large checkbox ✔ Then Large is checked and Text is unchecked for 2-D Drawing ✔ When the user presses Space ✔ Then 2D Sketches is added after 2-D Drawing ✔ And Large remains checked for 2-D Drawing ✔ And 3D Annotations is selected in the available list ✔ When the user presses Space again ✔ Then 3D Annotations is added after 2D Sketches ✔ And 2-D Drawing still has Large checked ✔ When the user cancels customization and reopens it for Part Tools ✔ Then the custom panel list is empty
